market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: The implied 1.4% probability is far too low for any IPL team, let alone the 2024 champions. In a 10-team league, a baseline chance is about 10%, and KKR's strong recent performance and good management suggest they are at least an average contender. This massive mispricing makes Yes a compelling bet.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL title and have a history of competitive teams (3 titles overall).
IPL consists of 10 teams; a naive fair probability is 10% per team, significantly above 1.4%.
Even with roster changes via mega auctions, franchise quality and scouting keep KKR's long-run odds well above 5%.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL structure, team counts, and historical parity
